Meet Dennis Ross

Dennis Ross: Navy veteran and Greater Orlando mortgage broker.

I am Dennis Ross, NMLS #2018381, the person behind DR. Mortgage USA. I help veterans, service members, military families, and Florida homebuyers understand VA and other mortgage choices with clear numbers before they apply.

The person behind the brand

Clear answers matter most when the decision feels heavy.

I served five years on active duty with two combat deployments and continued in the Navy Reserve, totaling fifteen years of military service.

After active duty, I earned a master’s degree in social work and built a career helping people navigate major life decisions. I entered the mortgage industry in 2020 with the same mindset: stay disciplined, stay accurate, and help people remain calm when the pressure is real.

Today I work with Florida first-time buyers, move-up buyers, veterans, single buyers, self-employed borrowers, homeowners, and investors who want to understand their choices without being pushed into a generic bank product.

For veterans, active-duty service members, and eligible military families, I provide VA home loan guidance across Greater Orlando, including Orlando, Lake Mary, Sanford, Winter Park, Altamonte Springs, and Oviedo.

Identity note: DR. Mortgage USA is my professional brand and educational website, not a separate lender or mortgage company. What clients should feel

The standard is not “loan closed.” The standard is “I understood the plan.”

01

You see the complete payment.

I bring the loan payment, taxes, insurance, HOA, mortgage insurance, and cash needed into the conversation early.

02

You compare real options.

As a wholesale broker, I can compare multiple lender paths instead of forcing every borrower into one menu.

03

You get a plain-language follow-up.

I recap the choices, missing information, and next action so you do not have to remember everything from one call.

04

You choose when to move forward.

We can start without a credit check. Sensitive information goes through the secure application only when you are ready.

Your next move

Start with a small conversation. Build trust from there.

Answer a few simple questions and I will help you find a clearer next step. No credit check is needed to start.
